quotes.text: The Philistines evidently held a monopoly in metal work in those days. Their blacksmiths were willing to sharpen agricultural implements for the Israelites, but would not provide them with metal weapons of war. Only Saul and Jonathan had a spear and sword; other soldiers among the Israelites evidently fought with weapons of stone and wood.
quotes.speaker: Daniel H. Ludlow
quotes.source: A Companion to Your Study of the Old Testament
quotes.attr: Daniel H. Ludlow, A Companion to Your Study of the Old Testament, 218
